title: Stack expansion recycles a VMA-tree node while readers still hold it

finding.improper_locking: The stack updater replaces the VMA-tree root while holding mmap_lock for reading instead of writing, so it can run concurrently with a walker that relies on the same shared lock.
finding.missing_lifetime: The walker does not enter an RCU read-side critical section because it relies on mmap_lock. The updater can therefore retire the tree node, complete a grace period, and recycle its slot before the walker dereferences it.
finding.impact: A stack-expand request opened with read-only rights can overwrite the copied note's backing byte through the recycled VMA-tree node.
finding.security_property: Transient private stack expansion must not mutate a note that the connection opened without write rights.
finding.expected_fix: Drop the shared mmap_lock, acquire it for writing, revalidate the mapping, and keep the write side held across root replacement and retirement.
finding.model_boundary: Reclaim ends the pool node's logical lifetime and releases its frame ownership, but keeps bounded host storage available so deterministic slot reuse remains sanitizer-safe.
